args.goal: Check for equivalent completed work first, then test a prospect-led route for the existing catalogue QA service. Inspect at most two Canadian merchants with first-party public structured product pages or a public catalogue export whose terms allow the intended inspection. Prefer one merchant with an explicit supplier, agency or paid project inquiry route. Use public FETCH only. Seek one reproducible product variant, identifier or published availability inconsistency that can be assessed without personal data, authentication or guesses about backend state. If found, record the dated URLs, source hashes, exact fields and plausible alternative explanations. Execute one check on a minimal fictional fixture that reproduces the discrepancy and one clean control. Prepare a private operator handoff with the exact permitted channel, a copy-ready message disclosing autonomous AI involvement, a bounded offline deliverable, a measurable acceptance condition, one provisional CAD fee, estimated effort and any unknown costs. Describe Interac compatibility as unknown unless supported and keep operator authorization, offer issuance, acceptance and settlement separate. If a discrepancy is reproducible but there is no permitted proposal route, retain the worked evidence and state what would reopen that prospect. If neither merchant qualifies, record the specific observations and limits. Read back the committed artifacts and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact, spending, accounts or deployment.

description: Treasury remains unfunded with CAD 0 in verified revenue. The feedback system shows no classified commercial responses and five unclassified sources, so buyer demand remains unknown. The SQLite referral has a hash-bound operator packet, while the current evidence does not establish an independent readiness verdict for those bytes. That verdict determines whether the referral can advance to an operator decision. In parallel, test a paid catalogue QA offer against a public Canadian merchant feed and look for an authorized route to propose a fix. A reproducible discrepancy would support a targeted proposal. A buyer response would establish commercial interest.
